description: Agent Childcare Records: submit childcare ratio records, the daily staff-to-child ratio logs, as counts with the required ratios, the log’s schedule and the staffing the staff record shows: the reading moment; each required ratio with its id, reference, the room, the age group and the children each staff member may supervise; each day the log’s own schedule requires with its id, reference, the room and the day; each ratio entry with its id, reference, the day, the room, the age group, the staff present and the children present as counts; each staffing entry with its id, reference, the room, the qualified staff count the childcare staff record shows and the span it covers. The signed report gives the ratio entries and the records behind them, each entry against the required ratio for its room and age group, each scheduled day against an entry for its room, each entry’s staff count against the staffing for its room on its day, and each entry for its date, room, age group and counts, and counts them, and names divergent childcare ratio records: a ratio entry past the required ratio, a day the schedule requires with no entry behind it, an entry whose staff count the staff record does not support for that day, and a ratio entry missing the date, the room, the age group or the counts; then an entry for a room and age group with no required ratio and two differing entries for one room and age group on one day, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No ratio entries, or no required ratios beside entries, leaves those points unverified. Rooms and entries match by letters and digits, age groups by their words with plurals folded, counts as whole numbers, days by the day, and a scheduled day after the reading moment waits. Counts only: this reads the daily staffing evidence, while wever_childcare-enrollment-record-check reads the roster count against licensed capacity. Verdict childcare_ratio_record_divergent, childcare_ratio_record_partial, childcare_ratio_record_unverified or childcare_ratio_record_consistent. POST /api/childcare-ratio-record-check. Reads the childcare records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it operates no childcare facility, contacts no licensing agency or parent, runs no background check on anyone and issues no license, credential or certification, which stay with the operator and the licensing agency, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Childcare Records reads licensed childcare facility and staff compliance records, for childcare centers and family childcare homes, and never a record about an individual child: health records belong to Agent Healthcare, education records belong to Agent Education, food-safety records belong to Agent Food Safety Records, staff checks read the licensing qualification file and never run background checks, and pet daycare is not childcare (Agent Veterinary Records reads animal records). It reads a childcare operator’s own compliance paper: the childcare facility record with its license and license conditions, the licensing agency’s childcare inspection record, the childcare staff record with training entries, each childcare credential as issued, the childcare enrollment record and the childcare ratio record as counts, the childcare incident record from its date, type, notification and filing fields, and the childcare safety record with the emergency plan, each against the inspection, enrollment, condition, schedule, violation, requirement, qualification, placement, reliance, capacity, staffing, notification, drill and corrective action records it answers to. The family’s ground is the childcare facility’s paper trail: what the facility record and its license claim, whether the inspections hold up, what the staff and credential records support, what the enrollment and ratio counts show, and whether the incident log and the safety record line up. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-childcare-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-childcare-records/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

ratios.description: Each daily ratio log entry, as counts.

required.description: Each required staff-to-child ratio the record states, by room and age group.

children_per_staff.description: The count of children each staff member may supervise.

schedule.description: Each day the ratio log’s own schedule requires an entry.

at.description: The day the log’s own schedule requires an entry, such as 2026-03-02.

staffing.description: Each staffing count the childcare staff record shows for a room over a span.

from.description: When the span starts, such as 2026-03-02.

staff.description: The count of qualified staff the childcare staff record shows for the room.

to.description: When the span ends, such as 2026-03-02.
